steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: High Priest, how is it looking?

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: I have to say, that cannon was so astoundingly loud, I almost got blown out of the thing when it fired!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I'm asking you about the Big, Ugly Thing.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: I was just sharing my personal situation with you. It went exactly as we expected. Firing the cannon in succession caused it to overheat.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: But it went very well. Yes, I have to say, it was very effective! Despite the fact that it gave me quite the scare!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: In any case, we will have to fix it up after we get back.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Yeah, the ceremony happened way too quickly. The Big Ugly wasn't ready yet.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I was hoping to wait until we finished it before talking to the other tribes about the ceremony, but they'd already gone ahead with it.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: It's okay. It all turned out fine!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: I still remember how shocked everyone was when they first saw the Big, Ugly Thing! Haha, that was so funny!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Yeah, we've accomplished our goal.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: This will set in motion a new order! A new era! Yes, an age of machines! That has such a nice ring to it!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: What do you think of the 'Age of Big Ugly'? Oh, maybe the 'Age of the High Priest' too. Yes, that sounds almost as cool as I do.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Let's just call it the age of machines.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Sheesh, you have a lot going for you, but you're still behind the times. Now that you've learned what it's like outside, you should try to expand your horizons!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Here, check out my outfit. Don't you think it's trendy? Looks smart?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: You're so short, I can't even see it. What does trendy mean, anyway?

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Argh, never mind. My mistake. I shouldn't have brought this up. But no matter. I'll pick out some clothes befitting you, our next Great Chief.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I don't mind how I dress. Anyway, I just got word from the tribesmen who stayed behind. They managed to steal an engine.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: What? Really?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Yes, apparently they got it from the transport Gavial used to get here.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Wonderful! I can't wait to take a good look at it!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Oh, come to think of it, I can go check it out right now! I'll see you later!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: The High Priest's the same as ever.

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Hey, who was the Liberi talking to the leader?

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: What, you new here? That's the High Priest! You know, the Big Ugly's pilot!

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: What? I want to pilot the Big Ugly!

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: Give it up. Before it was finished, that thing used to explode just about every day. So many hands got caught up in the explosions, in the end no one wanted to pilot it.

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: Then the High Priest came along, and he somehow managed to come back alive every time it blew up!

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: No kidding? He's that good?!

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: Yeah, I've got no idea what tribe he's from, but we all call him the High Priest now!

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Hm? Isn't that Yogi over there? Hey, Yogi.

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: Oh, it's you two.

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: I thought you were taking care of your brother. Where is he?

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: Actually, I'm going to the leader to talk about that.

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: You idiot, she's the Great Chief now!

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: Oh, I'm going to the Great Chief.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: What's the matter?

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: Great Chief, my brother has caught the Stone Disease.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Speak Sargonian.

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: Oh, yes, sorry. I'm not very good at speaking it yet.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: ...How did he catch the disease?

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: He wanted to mine more ores and went deeper into the mine. He didn't even listen to me when I told him not to...

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: That idiot! Didn't I tell you to stay away from the mine's depths?!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Where is he now?

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: Gavial took him away for treatment.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Gavial?

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: Yes, it looks like Gavial actually became a doctor. My brother was in a lot of pain, but he seemed much better after she patched him up a bit.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: ...So she really meant it when she said she's a doctor now.

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: She wanted me to pass along a message too.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: She said she was coming for you. She looked angry.

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Hmph, I bet she's just upset our leader defeated her!

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: That's right, leader! What you did back there. That boom! That was amazing!

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: You didn't call her Great Chief!

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: You didn't either!

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Get off my back, you moron! She'll always be our tribe leader!

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: Why don't you get off my back? I just haven't gotten used to calling her that yet!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Gavial isn't like that.

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: Great Chief, I trust Gavial.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Yes, I trust her too. Your brother will be fine. Where is he?

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: At Tomimi's tribe.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Tomimi's... You should go get your brother later.

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: I'm certain Gavial's here to get her engine back!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: ...She'll have to go through me to get it.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I'll admit that Gavial's strong, but she thinks her fists are everything.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: She's wrong.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: If she's here for her engine, then I'll give her another taste of the Big Ugly's might.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: ...But I won't give it back to her. This engine is very important to our tribe, no, our future.
Did you just mention Gavial?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Flint, did you hear that?

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Why don't you cry in your bed some more about the Great Chief?!

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: And why don't you go home to your mama and have her teach you what to call the Great Chief?!

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Knock it off, you two.

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Gah!

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: You... Kemar?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: You don't want her to come, do you?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: If she comes, I'll defeat her.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: So you don't you want her here. Then I'll stop her.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: I'll be going, then.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Back already?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Err, where is Gavial?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Tch, this rainforest's way too humid! I've barely hiked half a day and I'm already drenched in sweat! And I haven't seen a soul in the two days I've been here!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Thank goodness I wore my swimsuit underneath. What a lifesaver. I'm really getting my money's worth with it.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Really, though. Even when I climb the trees here, all I see is more trees! Just where's that ceremony Gavial was talking about?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hey, is anyone here?!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hey, Gavial, your tail's tiny!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hey, Doctor, maybe it's time for you to change that hood of yours!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: ...Tsk, they aren't within earshot.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Ugh, if something happens to the Doctor, what am I supposed to tell Amiya?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I guess I shouldn't worry since Gavial said she'd take care of the Doctor, but... I'm not sure that's all that reassuring, knowing her.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Urgh, the more I think about it, the more worried I am. Maybe I should try knocking a few trees down to make some noise.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: ...According to Yogi, I should find Gavial if I go this direction.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Whoa, finally! A person!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hey there!

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: I haven't seen clothes like that before. Who are you?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Huh? What are you saying?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: You don't understand me?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Urgh, is this for real? Gavial didn't tell me people here speak a different language!

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: But it looks like you can hold your own in a fight.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hey, c'mon! This how you people treat visitors?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Just as I thought, you're strong.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Before I take Gavial down, I'll have some fun with you first.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hm? Did she just say Gavial?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Whatever, I'm in a pretty bad mood right now. If you want to fight, then bring it on!
